summary: Retested the TOCTOU fix in lib/ai_quota.py enforce_ai_quota(). The burst slot is now reserved synchronously before the daily-cap await, and rolled back on both the Mongo-exception and daily-cap-reject paths. Confirmed the previously-broken concurrent-burst scenario now holds correctly, including run-twice-back-to-back and the daily-cap rollback-of-burst-slot behavior. All iteration_33 regressions still pass. One matrix item (strict serial 429-after-limit) is unreachable under real LLM latency independent of this fix -- documented as a note, not a bug.

checks.criterion: Concurrent AI burst limit now holds under race
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_quota_burst_race_twice.py::test_burst_limit_holds_under_race_twice_back_to_back
checks.evidence: Run 1: 6 concurrent POST /api/inventory/{id}/blurb (ThreadPoolExecutor, same session) -> 5x200 + 1x429 detail='Too many AI requests — please wait a moment'. Waited 10.5s to drain window. Run 2 (fresh 6 concurrent calls): identical shape, 5x200 + 1x429 'Too many AI requests'. Also reran the original single-shot test_tscheck_ai_quota_burst.py::test_burst_limit_blocks_sixth_rapid_blurb_call -> passed.

checks.criterion: Serial calls still succeed up to AI_BURST_LIMIT
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_quota_burst_serial.py::test_serial_burst_calls_then_drain_and_recover
checks.evidence: 5 fully-sequential (awaited) blurb calls all returned 200 (serial_results == [200]*5). Timed real blurb latency ~3-6s/call (measured directly: 4.42s, 4.95s, 4.73s, 2.95s, 2.87s, 5.71s across runs) means the 5 serial calls routinely exceed AI_BURST_WINDOW_SECONDS=10 in total (~20-25s), draining early window entries before the 6th call lands -- so the 6th frequently also returns 200 rather than 429. The test only asserts the strict 429 when elapsed<10s (branch not exercised under real latency) and always asserts recovery after waiting the window out (200). This mirrors iteration_33's documented finding that the burst cap is unreachable via a purely sequential realistic access pattern due to real LLM latency, independent of the TOCTOU race fix under test. Recorded as a NOTE (criterion/build disagree due to inherent third-party latency), not a regression of this fix — the fix's target (concurrent requests) is proven by the race-twice check above.

checks.criterion: Daily cap over-limit rolls back both the Mongo count AND the burst slot
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_quota_daily_rollback_burst.py::test_daily_cap_reject_rolls_back_burst_slot_across_six_calls
checks.evidence: Pre-inserted db.ai_quota{count:60} (at AI_DAILY_LIMIT). Fired 6 sequential blurb calls -> all 6 returned 429 with detail starting 'Daily AI quota reached' (none fell through to 'Too many AI requests', proving the burst slot reserved-then-popped on the daily-reject branch never accumulated). After db.ai_quota.delete_one(...), next call -> 200. Also reran original test_tscheck_ai_quota_daily.py single-reject case -> passed.

checks.criterion: Regression: Shop merge into disabled target still 422
checks.name: test_tscheck_shop_merge_disabled_target.py::test_merge_into_disabled_target_rejected_with_422_no_mutation
checks.evidence: DELETE /api/shops/{target} (disable) -> 200; DELETE /api/shops/{src}?mode=remove&reassign_to={disabled} -> 422 'Target shop is disabled — re-enable it before merging'; source shop + item location unchanged. Unchanged from iteration_33.

checks.criterion: Regression: Permissions-Policy and other headers still present
checks.name: test_tscheck_permissions_policy_header.py::test_permissions_policy_and_existing_security_headers_present
checks.evidence: GET /api/auth/me -> 200; permissions-policy contains camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(); x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, referrer-policy, strict-transport-security, content-security-policy all present and unchanged.

checks.criterion: Regression: ai_quota TTL + unique indexes still applied
checks.name: test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py::test_ai_quota_has_unique_user_bucket_and_ttl_indexes
checks.evidence: Failed only in a full-suite -n 2 --dist loadscope run co-scheduled with other slow AI-quota tests: 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed' (worker-teardown race). Passed standalone (python -m pytest tests/test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py -> 1 passed) and passed when grouped only with the daily tests. Same pre-existing xdist artifact iteration_33 flagged as informational.

checks.name: test_tscheck_sell_idempotency.py::test_replayed_sell_rejected_with_409_and_preserves_original_sale
checks.evidence: First PATCH /api/inventory/{id}/sell {sold:true, sold_price:5.00} -> 200. Replay with sold_price:99.99 -> 409 'Item is already marked sold'. Readback preserves sold_price=5.00. Unchanged from iteration_33.

action_items.detail: test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py intermittently fails with 'Event loop is closed' only under pytest-xdist loadscope when scheduled alongside other slow AI-quota tests; passes reliably standalone/grouped differently. No code change needed; purely an xdist worker-teardown timing artifact (also seen in iteration_33).

'Serial calls still succeed up to AI_BURST_LIMIT' criterion's strict 429-after-5-serial-calls assertion is not reachable with real LLM latency (observed ~3-6s/call -> 5 sequential calls can exceed the 10s burst window on their own before the 6th lands). This is inherent product latency, unrelated to the TOCTOU race fix verified in this iteration (which targets simultaneous/concurrent requests, proven passing). Not filed as a bug; flagged for product/spec awareness only.

test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py / test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating.py still fail on missing /tmp/item.jpg fixture; test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py still expects 14 seeded shops but finds 15 (Chiswick seed-flag residue). Both explicitly out-of-scope per spec_deviations, unchanged from iteration_33.
